summary: Impatience will tempt you to blow up a working system just because progress feels too slow.
body: Impatience will tempt you to blow up a working system just because progress feels too slow. When Mars squares Uranus, sudden, erratic restlessness can make every disruption look like a breakthrough. Sudden changes rarely fix structural flaws by themselves. Channel that adrenaline into a controlled experiment rather than setting fire to the routine that is keeping your life stable.
